bounded_host_request.command:
set -u
target='theGreatOldDaysofNipponGV'
match=''
while IFS= read -r unit; do
 [ -n "$unit" ] || continue
 body="$(systemctl --user cat "$unit" 2>/dev/null || true)"
 if printf '%s' "$body" | grep -Fqi "$target"; then
   [ -z "$match" ] || exit 86
   match="$unit"
 fi
done < <(systemctl --user list-unit-files --type=service --no-legend --plain 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')
[ -n "$match" ] || exit 87
systemctl --user is-active --quiet "$match" || exit 88
recent="$(journalctl --user -u "$match" --since '-15 minutes' --no-pager -o cat 2>/dev/null || true)"
if printf '%s' "$recent" | grep -Eiq 'traceback|permission denied|no space left|failed to save|I/O error|mount.*unavailable'; then exit 81; fi
if printf '%s' "$recent" | grep -Eiq 'download|video|message|progress|complete|saved'; then exit 80; fi
exit 82
